items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: The man was a hell of a pianist.

ctx.x: Yeah. Like Ramsey Lewis was playing rock. You know? He just took songs and sort of put a rock beat to it.

The man was a hell of a pianist. Yeah. There’s really nothing difficult, but the main thing is the rhythm. If you’re a pianist or you are a drummer or a bass player and you have that rhythm in your mind, you feel it you know, you can play it. Because it’s music, it’s compatible music. When you figure it all out it’s music.
Did you have a favorite span of years in your life where things were good at home, your work was good, the country seemed to be not in crisis.
